rows.text: The Commission's order of 7 August 1999 in Dispute Case No. 1 of 1999 begins: 'The Janata Dal ('JD' for short) is a recognised National party with the symbol 'Chakra (Wheel)' reserved for it.'
The order states: 'As per the Commission's records, Shri Sharad Yadav is the President of the party.'

'On 22.7.99, Shri Deve Gowda filed an application under paragraph 15 of the Symbols Order seeking a direction that the symbol 'Chakra (Wheel)', reserved for JD may be allotted to the group of the JD represented by him as the President.'
According to the application, the Political Affairs Committee of the JD, 'at its meeting held on 21.7.99', 'decided to remove Shri Yadav from the post of party President'.
The application further stated that the Political Affairs Committee, 'under the chairmanship of Vice-President Shri Maulana Obaidullah Khan Azmi, elected Shri Deve Gowda as the party President'.

For Shri Sharad Yadav it was stated that 'a meeting of the National Executive Committee was held on 29th July, 1999' which endorsed his decision to work with the Lok Shakti and the Samata Party and 'approved the action of Shri Yadav in suspending Shri Deve Gowda and Shri Jaipal Reddy from the party'.

locator.section: ORDER, paragraph 9 (compilation p. 333); also paragraph 6 (PDF page 4)

rows.text: The Commission found that 'the party has split vertically and both the groups are more or less evenly poised', granted 'provisional and ad-hoc recognition to both the rival groups as National parties' for the ensuing elections, and directed that 'neither of the said two groups or any other group shall be permitted to use the name of the Janata Dal or its reserved symbol 'Chakra (Wheel)', until further orders of the Commission'.

locator.section: ORDER: paragraph 14 on PDF page 7 (compilation p. 335), paragraph 16 on PDF page 8 (p. 336), and paragraph 18(iii) on PDF page 9 (p. 337)

rows.text: A note printed with the order in the compilation says that 'By subsequent order dated 07.08.1999, the Election Commission recognised the group led by Sh. Sharad Yadav by the name of Janata Dal (United) and reserved the symbol 'Arrow' for that group', and recognised the group led by Sh. H.D. Deve Gowda under the name of Janata Dal (Secular) with the symbol 'Farmer Driving Tractor'.

locator.section: compiler's summary of the case, Note (compilation p. 331)
